text:
On GitHub, athena/records gained no job, introspection or work-item records after the 25 Oct import (its last commit under records/jobs is f52d8f9ea9; later commits add only landing records). Main holds them, including job 20261029-073603-7kqv. docs/design/records-history.md section 13 says readers keep reading records/ on main until the cutover move. Make read_evidence in xtask/src/site.rs and read_snapshot in xtask/src/decisions.rs read records/ from the main tree in the Pages checkout, and also the records branch when present. Make the Pages build fail, instead of publishing a failure message, when the chosen evidence job cannot be read. Acceptance: a test builds the site from a repository whose records sit only on main and shows the evidence panel with models, verdict and costs, plus a proposal from November on decisions.html. cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test pass. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The homepage evidence panel and decisions.html read records from athena/records, which holds none after the 25 Oct import, so the live page shows a failure and leaves out newer proposals
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: athena/records, records/jobs, docs/design/records-history.md, records/, xtask/src/site.rs, xtask/src/decisions.rs, CHANGELOG.md
